'''Mario Saez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Madrid tournament]] on 11 November 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] and [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]], according to Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1460">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00d1460/ ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 15 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-15-ithor-madrid-spain-11-11-00d1460/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
